data.10|stepInfo[1].texts:
[LA_F]With Level Assist, the top 5
Idols by Lv become trainers
and raise the Lv of other Idols!
data.10|stepInfo[2].texts:
[LA_F]When you set an Idol in an Assist Slot,
they level up to the Assist Lv.
data.10|stepInfo[3].texts:
[LA_F]"Assist Lv" lets the top 5 Idols by Lv become Trainers and temporarily raise the Lv of other Idols.[LA_N_F]The raised Lv is updated to the
lowest Lv among the Trainers.
data.10|stepInfo[4].texts:
[LA_F]Friends bringing out the best in each other
is wonderful! Ahh~ So precious~
data.11|stepInfo[1].texts:
[LA_F]You can join a Union of your choice
from among the 8 Unions.[LA_N_F]Unions hold Live Battles
against each other, competing over
which is the strongest.[LA_N_F]Except during specific periods, you
can transfer at any time.[LA_N_F]Let's join one right away.
data.11|stepInfo[2].texts:
[LA_F]You can earn Union Medals just by visiting the Union every day.
Use Medals for "Staff Development" to power up your Idols' parameters.
data.12|stepInfo[0].texts: [LA_F]You can now check the VENUS Program Ranking!
data.12|stepInfo[1].texts:
[LA_F]Earn VENUS Points and aim for the top of the VENUS Program.
VENUS Points can be earned in Main Live, VENUS Tower, VENUS Battle, and Union Live.
data.12|stepInfo[2].texts:
[LA_F]Our goal is the top of the
VENUS Program!
data.14|stepInfo[1].texts:
[LA_F]You can use "Advance Film" to raise a Photo's quality.
Raising the quality increases the Photo's effect values.
data.15|stepInfo[1].texts:
[LA_F]You can use "Recycling Film" to reroll a Photo's effects.
Please note that it may no longer be a Photo exclusive to a specific Idol.
data.16|stepInfo[1].texts:
[LA_F]Combining 3 of the same Accs gives you an Accs one rank higher.
They're important for boosting Live Score, so combine them actively.
data.18|stepInfo[0].texts:
[LA_F]During the period, you battle all other Unions in a round-robin. Beat the other Union's Managers in Live Battles.
Victory is decided by each Union's total high scores during the battle period.
data.19|stepInfo[1].texts: [LA_F]Returns a developed Idol to Lv1 and refunds the Lesson Pieces, Skill Powder, Yell Powder, and Potential Pieces consumed. Combine it well with "Level Assist" to make the most of it.
data.1|stepInfo[10].texts:
[LA_F]For the next stage, let's have
these Members perform!
data.1|stepInfo[11].texts: [LA_F]You can change your Formation here.[LA_N_F]If you're stuck, "Auto" will automatically build a Unit suited to the Live.
data.1|stepInfo[12].texts:
[LA_F]Oh! Look, Senpai!
It seems the fans have come to the Live!
data.1|stepInfo[13].texts:
[LA_F]The number of attending Fans affects
your Live Score.[LA_N_F]Earning Fans through "Work" also
increases the number of Fans
who come to your Live.
data.1|stepInfo[14].texts:
[LA_F]We have to work hard on "Work" and let
so many more fans get to know
Hoshimi Pro!
I'll do my best too!
data.1|stepInfo[15].texts:
[LA_F]The Live is finally about to begin.[LA_N_F]I'm getting kind of nervous...!
You're so calm, Senpai—as expected!
data.1|stepInfo[16].texts:
[LA_F]Starting the VENUS Program's score
measurement system.[LA_N_F]AI judging quantifies the Idols'
performance.[LA_N_F]The Idols perform autonomously, so no Manager operation or intervention is needed.[LA_N_F]Feedback automatically judged by the system is displayed.[LA_N_F]Starting the Rehearsal.
data.1|stepInfo[17].texts:
[LA_F]The score of each Idol
is measured to the "Beat."
data.1|stepInfo[18].texts: [LA_F]The score you can earn from Beats is determined by an Idol's combined Vocal, Dance, and Visual values.
data.1|stepInfo[19].texts: [LA_F]If you place an Idol who has an "Appeal Skill," they consume Stamina to activate the Skill.
data.1|stepInfo[1].texts:
[LA_F]Senpai!
Let's do our best today too![LA_N_F]Um, first
let's check today's schedule...[LA_N_F]A Live...
and lessons...[LA_N_F]Hmm, it looks like
a busy day ahead!
data.1|stepInfo[20].texts: [LA_F]"Appeal Skills" can earn high scores and, in some cases, bring various effects.
data.1|stepInfo[21].texts: [LA_F]Only limited Idols have "Special Skills," so be careful with placement.
data.1|stepInfo[22].texts: [LA_F]"Special Skills" can earn a very high score rating.
data.1|stepInfo[23].texts: [LA_F]The type and number of Skill Chances differ by placement.[LA_N_F]Try devising your Unit combinations and Idol placement to match the Live.
data.1|stepInfo[24].texts: [LA_F]When the score earned from Beats and Skills reaches the target, the Live is a success.
data.1|stepInfo[25].texts:
[LA_F]The VENUS Program really
is amazing![LA_N_F]"AI-based automatic judging" sounds
so difficult, and it'd take me
ages just to learn it.
data.1|stepInfo[26].texts:
[LA_F]When the VENUS Program is too hard,
or you just want to know the results, it seems you can check the Highlight.
data.1|stepInfo[27].texts:
[LA_F]In the Highlight, you can check only
the Skill activation results and
the score earned.[LA_N_F]You can also long-press the screen to
switch to double speed.
data.1|stepInfo[28].texts:
[LA_F]When you want to know how the Idols did and the results,
the Highlight is easy to follow![LA_N_F]That's all for the Rehearsal.
Now for the real Live.
So exciting...!
data.1|stepInfo[29].texts:
[LA_F]Great work at the Live!
Ahh~ So precious~
[LA_N_F]It's our mission to guide
the Hoshimi Pro members
to the top, right![LA_N_F]Let's keep working hard
and aim for a packed
Live at a big venue!
data.1|stepInfo[2].texts:
[LA_F]Let's head to the Live Venue
right away!
data.1|stepInfo[30].texts:
[LA_F]Even after the Live, everyone's
already back to practicing!
data.1|stepInfo[32].texts:
[LA_F]In "Self-Training," you can earn rewards according to the actual passage of time.[LA_N_F]Results keep increasing
even while the app is closed.[LA_N_F]If a certain time passes without checking the results, the Idol takes a break.
data.1|stepInfo[33].texts: [LA_F]The amount of Rewards per time increases as you progress through Main Live.
data.1|stepInfo[34].texts:
[LA_F]Everyone's working hard at
training every day![LA_N_F]Alright, I'll support them without losing either!
data.1|stepInfo[36].texts:
[LA_F]Now, next let's help
everyone with their lessons!
data.1|stepInfo[38].texts:
[LA_F]Umm... this time...
it was Ms. Nagase's lesson.
data.1|stepInfo[39].texts:
[LA_F]By consuming "Lesson Pieces,"
you can raise
your Idols' Lv.
data.1|stepInfo[40].texts:
[LA_F]By giving an Idol lessons,
you can raise their parameters and
learn Skills.
data.1|stepInfo[41].texts:
[LA_F]Daily lessons are essential to
hype up the Live!
data.1|stepInfo[43].texts:
[LA_F]The Members are working hard,
so next it's about what Unit
will appear in the Live![LA_N_F]From here you can set up
the Formation of Members appearing in the Live!
data.1|stepInfo[44].texts:
[LA_F]In Formation,
you combine Idols, Photos, and Accs
to build a Unit.
data.1|stepInfo[45].texts: [LA_F]The order of Idols relates to their respective positions in the Live.[LA_N_F]Placement affects Skill activation and the Live staging.
data.1|stepInfo[48].texts:
[LA_F]It's important to form a unit to match the Live,
but at first, let's make use of
"Auto".
data.1|stepInfo[49].texts:
[LA_F]Huh!
You're leaving it to me!?[LA_N_F]Th-that's too much of an honor... but just
imagining what Members will form
the Unit makes me excited!
Haah~ A feast for the eyes.
data.1|stepInfo[4].texts: [LA_F]In Main Live, clearing all the Lives at each Venue lets you advance to the next Venue.
data.1|stepInfo[51].texts:
[LA_F]How about that!
So precious, if I do say so myself~
data.1|stepInfo[57].texts:
[LA_F]Senpai, are you always
replying to your messages?[LA_N_F]Daily communication is
really important!
data.1|stepInfo[60].texts:
[LA_F]Depending on your actions,
you may receive messages.[LA_N_F]As you reply to messages,
you may get
more intimate messages.[LA_N_F]Also, as you keep interacting,
"Phone Calls" and office "Conversations"
may occur.
data.1|stepInfo[62].texts:
[LA_F]Turning notifications ON lets you notice Members' messages anytime.

It's a feature that makes the game more fun, so please turn it ON and enjoy.
data.1|stepInfo[63].texts:
[LA_F]We should keep notifications ON
so we can respond whenever a message arrives![LA_N_F]After all, we are
Managers!
data.1|stepInfo[64].texts:
[LA_F]This concludes the tutorial.
Please continue to enjoy IDOLY PRIDE.[LA_N_F]Returning to the Title.
data.1|stepInfo[6].texts:
[LA_F]Now then! Let's go over
the details of this Live!
data.1|stepInfo[7].texts: [LA_F]In Lives, there are 3 types of parameters that give an advantage depending on placement.
data.1|stepInfo[8].texts:
[LA_F]Pink: Vocal
Blue: Dance
Yellow: Visual
That's how they're set up.[LA_N_F]Place appropriate Idols—for example, Idols good at Vocal in the Vocal spot.
data.1|stepInfo[9].texts:
[LA_F]You can check and change
the Idols appearing in the Live here.
data.20|stepInfo[0].texts:
[LA_F]You can earn "Red Diamonds" based on results such as login days up to the day before the last day of each month and Manager Lv.
Your salary is paid at 12:00 on the last day of each month.
data.21|stepInfo[1].texts: [LA_F]On the Bulletin Board, you can interact with other Managers.[LA_N_F]Be sure to follow good manners!
data.22|stepInfo[0].texts:
[LA_F]Now that the Idol's Lv has increased,
you can strengthen Live Skills!
data.22|stepInfo[1].texts:
[LA_F]Strengthening Live Skills makes
their effects more powerful, and
they'll shine in Lives![LA_N_F]The Skill Powder needed to strengthen
them can be obtained from
Fan Events.
data.23|stepInfo[0].texts:
[LA_F]Manage the Idols' activities and lead the Training Camp to success!
First, take on a Training Stage!
data.23|stepInfo[1].texts:
[LA_F]Choose a menu within the limited number of days and aim for the goal!
Which menu you pick is up to you!
Earn various Live Bonuses and make the Live a success!
data.23|stepInfo[2].texts:
[LA_F]Use the Live Bonus earned in Training Stages to take on the Main Stage!
You can redo Training Stages to refresh the Live Bonus too.
data.24|stepInfo[0].texts:
[LA_F]Memories are special Idols from a different time and world.
They cannot be sent to Work, and their Fan Count and Core Fan Rate are the average of all Idols.
data.25|stepInfo[0].texts:
[LA_F]Play Lives to earn Mini Lynx Medals.
When the BOX gauge is full, you can pull the BOX Gacha.
data.26|stepInfo[0].texts: [LA_F]Limit Break your Accs to aim for even greater ability upgrades!
data.27|stepInfo[0].texts:
[LA_F]Advance spaces using "Race Pt" earned based on elapsed time.
The amount of "Race Pt" and "Race Medals" earned increases by clearing Efficiency UP Stages.
data.28|stepInfo[0].texts: [LA_F]Use the "Pt" you earn from Missions and Work to get the rewards you want! Some rewards come with messages, letting you enjoy Event-exclusive group messages too.
data.29|stepInfo[1].texts:
[LA_F]In Photo Retouch, you can rewrite a Photo's quality, rarity, and options exactly as the recipe specifies.
Retouch your favorite Photos and equip them to your Idols.
data.2|stepInfo[0].texts:
[LA_F]You can now do "Photography"!
Let's take some photos right away!
data.2|stepInfo[10].texts:
[LA_F]From the shots you've taken, choose
the one to make into a "Photo"!
data.2|stepInfo[12].texts:
[LA_F]The "quality" of a Photo changes
depending on the Film used.[LA_N_F]A Photo's rarity and effects are
decided at random.[LA_N_F]They're important for raising Live Score,
so once you get Film, take a shoot.
data.2|stepInfo[2].texts:
[LA_F]You can select the character, Outfit,
Song, and stage to shoot![LA_N_F]This time, let's try shooting
with these Members!
data.2|stepInfo[6].texts:
[LA_F]In Shoot Mode, you can freely
take "Photos"!
[LA_N_F]The "Photos" you take can be set
on everyone in Unit Formation!
data.2|stepInfo[7].texts: [LA_F]Just TAP the button and you can take a photo whenever you like!
data.2|stepInfo[8].texts:
[LA_F]This is a trial shoot, so
let's just go with "Auto"!
data.30|stepInfo[0].texts:
[LA_F]Collab Idols, like Memories, are special Idols from a different time and world.
They cannot be sent to Work, and their Fan Count and Core Fan Rate are the average of all Idols.
data.31|stepInfo[0].texts:
[LA_F]Ask other Managers for help, or help them, and aim for a successful Live!
Clear Co-op Lives to earn all kinds of Rewards.
data.32|stepInfo[0].texts:
[LA_F]1 week is treated as 1 season, and battles take place automatically at a fixed time every day.
From day 2 onward, battles are held by checking the previous day's results.
data.33|stepInfo[0].texts: [LA_F]Potential Pieces allow you to raise an Idol's Potential Rank. An Idol's actual Lv cap is the combined value of their ★ (Rarity) and Potential Rank.
data.36|stepInfo[0].texts:
[LA_F]Let's generate a Base Photo stage.
Depending on the Rarity, quality, and Option similarity of the Base and Material Photos, the difficulty GRADE, number of stages, increase value, and growth rate vary.
data.37|stepInfo[0].texts:
[LA_F]The effect values of the Base Photo's Options increase according to the progress of the generated stage.
You can also SKIP some stages according to Main Live progress.
data.38|stepInfo[0].texts: [LA_F]Photo Album is content that lets you photograph Event Stories.
data.38|stepInfo[1].texts: [LA_F]Use the Photos you've taken to create your own album.
data.38|stepInfo[2].texts: [LA_F]Photos taken of Stories and Album Photos can be developed using "Event Development Film."
data.39|stepInfo[0].texts:
[LA_F]Memories and Collab Idols are special Idols from a different time and world.
You cannot interact with them, and their Interaction Lv changes according to the average Interaction Pt of your recruited Idols.
data.3|stepInfo[0].texts:
[LA_F]Whaa~t!
It looks like the Idols are
gradually gaining Fans!
data.3|stepInfo[10].texts:
[LA_F]Interacting with fans raises
your "Fan Satisfaction"![LA_N_F]The rewards change depending on
the Satisfaction at the end of the event!
data.3|stepInfo[11].texts:
[LA_F]Each handshake decreases a character's
Vigor.[LA_N_F]When everyone's Vigor runs out,
the Fan Event ends!
Wow~ The Idols are all
super busy too!
data.3|stepInfo[13].texts:
[LA_F]Oh! There's a fan who
brought us a Fan Letter!
data.3|stepInfo[15].texts:
[LA_F]Receiving a Fan Letter
raises the Support Gauge.[LA_N_F]When the Support Gauge fills up, you can call other Idols in to support.
data.3|stepInfo[17].texts:
[LA_F]You can enter the FEVER state
by using an item.
data.3|stepInfo[1].texts:
[LA_F]Let's hold a Fan Event that
delights all the fans!
data.3|stepInfo[21].texts:
[LA_F]During FEVER, you can earn a lot
of "Fan Satisfaction"!
data.3|stepInfo[23].texts:
[LA_F]The fan seems pleased,
so this is perfect timing![LA_N_F]Let's have the next fan
take their place.
data.3|stepInfo[24].texts:
[LA_F]During FEVER, tapping with good timing
lets you gain high Satisfaction
data.3|stepInfo[26].texts:
[LA_F]Whoa!
The Support Gauge is full!
Let's call in some support!
data.3|stepInfo[27].texts:
[LA_F]While a Cheer Idol is present,
the Satisfaction you earn increases!
data.3|stepInfo[29].texts:
[LA_F]Work seems to be going well!
Haah~ A feast for the eyes~[LA_N_F]Leave the site to the Idols,
and let's return to the office.[LA_N_F]Please give instructions to the Idols
who will do the next Fan Event.
data.3|stepInfo[2].texts:
[LA_F]In Fan Events, each Idol's
"Core Fan Rate" increases![LA_N_F]The higher the "Core Fan Rate,"
the higher the proportion of fans
who come to Lives—so it's important!
data.3|stepInfo[5].texts: [LA_F]This time, let's have everyone here take on the Work.
data.3|stepInfo[8].texts:
[LA_F]Fan Events are important Work
that lets fans have fun!
Let's support them with enthusiasm!
data.40|stepInfo[0].texts:
[LA_F]Staff Risers allow you to raise the Potential Rank of Staff Training.
Raising the Potential Rank increases the Lv cap of Staff Training.
data.41|stepInfo[0].texts:
[LA_F]Office Rank has been unlocked!
Let's check it out!
data.45|stepInfo[0].texts:
[LA_F]Bond Awakening Limited Idols are special Idols who undergo Bond Awakening when you obtain them twice.
Bond Awakening changes their illustration, and lets you obtain a second Outfit and unlock a fourth Skill.
data.4|stepInfo[10].texts:
[LA_F]It seems we've received
the Work rewards![LA_N_F]From here you can check the Work
results for the elapsed time!
data.4|stepInfo[11].texts:
[LA_F]We did it!
Our Fans increased a little![LA_N_F]Steady effort, one step at a time![LA_N_F]Let's do Work every day so
we can get offers for
big jobs!
data.4|stepInfo[12].texts:
[LA_F]Work progresses automatically
even while the app is closed.[LA_N_F]Keep track of the Idols' Energy and
give precise instructions.
data.4|stepInfo[1].texts:
[LA_F]In Promotion, you can earn
Fans. You can also get
various other rewards.
data.4|stepInfo[3].texts: [LA_F]This time, let's have these Members take on the Work.
data.4|stepInfo[5].texts:
[LA_F]This is the time until it ends.
It continues automatically until the
Idols sent to Work run out of Vigor.
data.4|stepInfo[7].texts: [LA_F]Using an item lets you advance Work time all at once.
data.5|stepInfo[0].texts:
[LA_F]I almost forgot something important!
Is there any Member who
seems tired?
data.5|stepInfo[1].texts:
[LA_F]Don't forget to secure rest time
and have them "Refresh"
too!
data.5|stepInfo[3].texts: [LA_F]Refresh lets you spend Coins to restore an Idol's Vigor.[LA_N_F]Vigor recovers naturally when not working, but Refresh lets you restore much more.
data.5|stepInfo[4].texts: [LA_F]Let's make sure the Idols always stay in good spirits!
data.6|stepInfo[1].texts:
[LA_F]In High Score Live, you compete for rank
with your score on each Song
data.6|stepInfo[2].texts:
[LA_F]Songs you can challenge are unlocked as you progress through Main Live.[LA_N_F]Raising your total high score across all Songs
lets you earn gorgeous Rewards
from Missions.
data.6|stepInfo[3].texts:
[LA_F]Get creative with your Unit Formation to
match the Song, and aim to
set new high scores!
data.7|stepInfo[1].texts: [LA_F]We can finally take part in VENUS Battle!
data.7|stepInfo[2].texts:
[LA_F]It looks like you select your
opponent here![LA_N_F]Units with a high VENUS Rate are
tough, but beating them raises
your Rate a lot!
data.7|stepInfo[3].texts:
[LA_F]Rankings are decided by your
VENUS Rate at the end of the set season
data.7|stepInfo[4].texts:
[LA_F]It looks like you can check Rewards
and rankings here![LA_N_F]Let's aim for the top!
data.8|stepInfo[1].texts:
[LA_F]In Daily Live, you can obtain lots
of various items.
data.8|stepInfo[2].texts:
[LA_F]Daily Live requires
a "Live Pass."[LA_N_F]3 free passes are
distributed every day![LA_N_F]Free passes reset at 0:00 every day,
so don't miss a single day—
let's do Lives every day!
data.9|stepInfo[1].texts:
[LA_F]VENUS Tower is a Live where clearing
takes you to the STAGE above.[LA_N_F]The further up you go, the more difficult it becomes.
data.9|stepInfo[2].texts:
[LA_F]Clear each STAGE to earn
gorgeous Rewards![LA_N_F]To show your presence in the
VENUS Program, keep advancing
and make Hoshimi Pro's name known!
